scope: Major off-road adventure, destination arrival/parking, natural passenger interaction, return descent, practical driving explanation and outro.

sourceEvidence.frameBoundaryNote: The bundle package was split at a chunk boundary. Several final frame samples were not physically present in bundle 004 and were expected to continue in bundle 005; this must not be treated as loss of source video evidence until the next bundle is checked.

editorialObjective: Use the genuine off-road adventure as the major payoff to the early hook, preserve authentic reactions, show arrival and weather/road texture, keep the practical information compact, and avoid turning the driving explanation into a tutorial.

storyBeats.detail: Rocky dirt-road driving becomes a sustained high-value sequence rather than a generic travel montage. The terrain visibly supports the narration about roughness and ground clearance.
Direct-to-camera and passenger interaction provide authentic excitement and humour during the climb.
Arrival/parking material confirms movement from rough route into destination space with vehicles, people, buildings and mountain surroundings.
A later explicit 'one more off-road' sequence creates a second escalation and directly fulfils the promise made in the hook.
Natural in-car interaction gives human texture and a breath between physically intense road sections.
Descent footage plus worsening/wet conditions provides a visual and tonal move toward closing.
Practical commentary about rough-road/rain driving can survive in a short covered section; it should not dominate the ending.
Natural wrap-up speech is preserved as the closing anchor.
